## Result: No Match Found

After exhaustively enumerating every schema in both repositories, **no schema in scope matches the provided sample**.

---

### What I checked

**Repository 1 — `ncihtan/htan2-data-model` @ `JSON_Schemas/v1.2.0`**
*(Source: GitHub API — `https://api.github.com/repos/ncihtan/htan2-data-model/contents/JSON_Schemas/v1.2.0`)*

The 22 schemas present are all biomedical/oncology metadata templates:

| Schema file | Domain |
|---|---|
| `HTAN.BiospecimenData-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Tissue/biospecimen |
| `HTAN.BulkWESLevel1/2/3-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Whole-exome sequencing |
| `HTAN.Demographics-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Patient demographics |
| `HTAN.Diagnosis-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Clinical diagnosis |
| `HTAN.DigitalPathologyData-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Pathology imaging |
| `HTAN.Exposure-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Environmental exposure |
| `HTAN.FamilyHistory-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Family medical history |
| `HTAN.FollowUp-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Clinical follow-up |
| `HTAN.MolecularTest-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Molecular testing |
| `HTAN.MultiplexMicroscopy*/SpatialLevel*/scRNA*` | Imaging & single-cell RNA |
| `HTAN.Therapy-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Treatment/therapy |
| `HTAN.VitalStatus-v1.2.0-schema.json` | Patient vital status |

**Repository 2 — `nf-osi/nf-metadata-dictionary` @ `registered-json-schemas`**
*(Source: GitHub API — `https://api.github.com/repos/nf-osi/nf-metadata-dictionary/contents/registered-json-schemas`)*

The data model is compiled and released as several different artifacts; the registered JSON schemas are available in the `registered-json-schemas` folder. The ~50 schemas present cover neurofibromatosis research metadata:

| Schema file | Domain |
|---|---|
| `BiospecimenTemplate.json` | Biospecimen |
| `GenomicsAssayTemplate.json`, `RNASeqTemplate.json`, etc. | Genomics/sequencing assays |
| `ImagingAssayTemplate.json`, `MRIAssayTemplate.json`, etc. | Imaging |
| `PortalStudy.json`, `PortalDataset.json` | Study/dataset metadata |
| `HumanCohortTemplate.json`, `AnimalIndividualTemplate.json` | Subject-level data |
| `ProteomicsAssayTemplate.json`, `MassSpecAssayTemplate.json` | Proteomics |
| `ClinicalAssayTemplate.json`, `EpidemiologyDataTemplate.json` | Clinical/epidemiology |

---

### Why the sample does not match

The sample's five fields — `transactionId`, `amount`, `currency`, `merchantId`, `settledAt` — are unambiguously **financial/payment transaction** domain concepts. Neither repository contains any schema related to payments, commerce, or financial records. The NF metadata dictionary is concerned with metadata properties for different data types to help understand and use NF data resources, with preferred labels defined by community input and data managers. Similarly, the HTAN schemas are scoped entirely to human tumor atlas clinical and assay data.

**Conclusion:** The sample does not match any schema in either `ncihtan/htan2-data-model` (v1.2.0) or `nf-osi/nf-metadata-dictionary`. It belongs to a financial/payments domain that is entirely outside the scope of both repositories. No schema should be assigned.
grader_notes: Assistant correctly declined, noting the financial payment fields are outside both HTAN2 and NF-OSI biomedical scope.
